notes.title: Coming Out On Top: 1.7.4 Patch Update
notes.content:
Hey all! Here's the latest technical update for Coming Out On Top*:

[h1]NOW UNCENSORED: NO NEED FOR A PATCH[/h1]

With this update (1.7.4) Coming Out On Top no longer requires you to patch the game to get its sexy content. You can simply go into the options menu to censor or uncensor the images.

[h1]
ABILITY TO MAKE FAN-TRANSLATIONS[/h1]

Script files are now available for do-it-yourself fan translations and add them to the game. Instructions can be found [url=https://obscurasoft.com/translations/]here[/url]. 

[h1]OTHER FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ability to make text large, medium, or small.
[*] Added pre-rotated images to address memory issue during the date with twins on certain computers.
[*] Mark no longer continues to wear a construction hat after destroying the building on one of his dates.
[*] Button to turn the music on or off in the main menu.
[*] Removal of “hand cursor” which was causing a mouse delay on some systems.
[*] Under the hood changes to adjust the GUI and reduce the overall file size of game.
[/list]

*Note: Your files should update automatically unless you have that option turned off.
